input: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

companies.name: Riege Software International GmbH
companies.employees: 51–200 employees, company-profile estimate observed_as_of 2026-11-10; source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/riege . Latest verified legal-entity count: 97 average employees during FY2024, accounts published 2026-03-31; source_url: https://www.validatis.de/unternehmen/riege-software-international-gmbh-8f617039-254a-44aa-b67d-0291b806b05e/

criteria_evidence.evidence: In its history of Scope, published 2025-09-30, Riege explains that the founders built a financially sound business that could finance the product's redevelopment independently, without banks or investors. This provides affirmative self-financing evidence rather than relying solely on an absence of funding announcements.

The 2026-07-29 leadership announcement explicitly states that Riege remains in family hands, is run by second-generation siblings, and has remained privately held since its founding in 1985. Its newsroom continues to describe the business as family-owned, observed_as_of 2026-11-10.

The company imprint identifies Riege Software International GmbH, commercial register Neuss HRB 4207, at Otto-Hahn-Straße 4, Meerbusch, Germany, and identifies riege.com as its website. Observed_as_of 2026-11-10.
The company's public profile identifies its headquarters as Meerbusch, NRW, Germany. Observed_as_of 2026-11-10.

The exact legal entity's TÜV SÜD certificate covers operating a SaaS platform for logistics applications in customs, air freight and sea freight. Certificate issued 2025-10-27 and valid from 2025-11-01 through 2028-12-12.

The 2026-07-29 company announcement identifies Scope as its cloud-based transport management system for air freight, sea freight and customs—not a freight brokerage or a general-purpose software consultancy.
Registry-derived standalone accounts report 97 average employees during FY2024, published 2026-03-31. This is an entity-specific count rather than an aggregation of subsidiaries.
The company's public profile reports a size range of 51–200 employees, observed_as_of 2026-11-10, corroborating the target size band beyond the historical accounts.
The Logistik-Initiative Hamburg membership list, as_of 2025-01-01, lists the exact entity Riege Software International GmbH.

companies.headcount_growth: Average legal-entity headcount increased from 90 during FY2023 to 97 during FY2024, a reported increase of 7.8%. These are comparable annual averages, not LinkedIn-associated profile counts. FY2024 accounts published 2026-03-31; source_url: https://www.validatis.de/unternehmen/riege-software-international-gmbh-8f617039-254a-44aa-b67d-0291b806b05e/
companies.traction: Scope was used by more than 900 companies across 60 countries as_of 2026-07-29, according to the company's announcement; source_url: https://www.riege.com/company/press/press-releases/riege-software-names-christian-riege-as-new-ceo
companies.rank_reason: Verified fit across the requested gates: European headquarters, freight-specific SaaS, affirmative internally financed product-development history, continuing private family ownership, and an entity-specific employee count within the target range.

output.search_notes: Research_as_of: 2026-11-10. Only the company above cleared every criterion on the evidence reviewed; this is not a claim that no other qualifying European businesses exist. Bootstrapping required affirmative self-financing evidence, not simply an empty funding database. Sources reviewed included company histories and newsrooms, registry-derived accounts, association member lists, trade-show exhibitor guides, and local business publications. Important exclusions: Ongoing Warehouse received Cinven investment announced 2026-05-06 and appears in Cinven's portfolio; source_urls: https://www.cinven.com/news-insights/cinven-to-invest-in-ongoing-warehouse-alongside-founders/ and https://www.cinven.com/portfolio/ . Fargo Systems received August Equity investment announced 2024-10-02 and remains in its portfolio as Fargo Group; source_urls: https://www.augustequity.com/news-insights/august-equity-announces-investment-in-fargo-systems/ and https://www.augustequity.com/portfolio/fargo-group/ . Track-POD has affirmative bootstrapping evidence, but the opened source reports only an 11–50 employee band, which does not establish that it meets the minimum; source_url: https://userp.io/case-study/track-pod/ . Riege's latest verified statutory headcount relates to FY2024, not a November 2026 census; its current public profile corroborates the requested range. missing_fields: Riege Software International GmbH.last_round — no verifiable dated funding round was established; null should not be interpreted as a certified lifetime funding total.

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
